objective_value: <float> Total operational cost across all optimized ships including waiting, handling, delay, latest-finish-time penalty, and fuel costs in US dollars.

ships.ship_id: <int> Identifier of the optimized ship matching the input data.

port_visits.port_call_index: <int> Position of this visit in the ship's route sequence, starting from 1.
port_visits.port_id: <str> Identifier of the port being visited at this port call.
port_visits.berthing_position: <float> Assigned leftmost quay coordinate in meters where the ship berths at this port call.
port_visits.start_time: <float> Hour at which the ship begins berthing at this port call.
port_visits.handling_time: <float> Actual cargo handling duration in hours at this port call, inflated by the deviation from the ideal berthing position.
port_visits.arrival_time: <float> Hour at which the ship arrives at the port and becomes ready to berth for this port call.
port_visits.delay: <float> Hours by which the berthing end time exceeds the expected finish time, zero if on time.
port_visits.lft_violation: <float> Hours by which the berthing end time exceeds the latest finish time, zero if within the limit.
port_visits.position_deviation: <float> Absolute distance in meters between the assigned berthing position and the ideal berthing position.

speed_selections.from_call: <int> Port call index of the departure port for this sailing leg.
speed_selections.to_call: <int> Port call index of the arrival port for this sailing leg.
speed_selections.speed_knots: <float> Sailing speed chosen in knots for this sailing leg between consecutive port visits.
